critic raised a concrete objection: You anchored FY2026Q3 to FY2024Q3 (6.29) and applied a two-year CAGR, but the correct comparable is the immediately prior-year quarter, FY2025Q3. Deere’s FY2025 Q3 diluted EPS was reported (Aug 2025), so using FY2024Q3 carries forward an extra year and puts the estimate on the wrong period basis.
Worldwide net sales and revenues: critic raised a concrete objection: You used a -8.6% YoY change for FY2024Q3→FY2025Q3, but Deere explicitly reported that Worldwide net sales and revenues decreased 9% to $12.018 billion in Q3 FY2025. That mismatch suggests you’re not on the same “Worldwide net sales and revenues” basis (likely mixing in a different series or adjustment), so the blended -11.68% YoY and resulting 10,614.8 USDm forecast rest on the wrong basis.
Production & Precision Ag operating prof: critic raised a concrete objection: The “YoY growth −12.65%” you applied is not an actual year-over-year rate for FY2026Q3; it’s a synthetic weighted blend of two unrelated historical moves (FY2024Q3→FY2025Q3 −50.1% and FY2020Q3→FY2021Q3 +49.8%). YoY for FY2026Q3 should reflect the change from FY2025Q3 to FY2026Q3 (e.g., guidance or consensus for that period), not a mix that includes 2020→2021. Using that blended −12.65% to compute 580 × (1−0.1265) = 506.6 puts the estimate on the wrong basis.
